jsonld.headline: Excited to share that Splita has been selected for the Virtual Showcase at the 2026 Yale University Innovation Summit.
jsonld.articleBody:
Excited to share that Splita has been selected for the Virtual Showcase at the 2026 Yale University Innovation Summit. 

Group payments for college students and young adults have always been the same story. One person pays, others owe them, and 9 times out of 10, you don't get paid the full amount back. At Splita, we are changing that. Everyone puts in their share before the charge goes through. No one floats the bill, no one has to ask twice.

The Summit brings together 2,500+ founders, investors, and researchers across the country. If you're attending or want to learn more about what we're building, feel free to reach out.

Learn more: www.splita.co

#YaleInnovation26 #Fintech #Startups #Entrepreneurship

Will Clarkson Dayo Adebari Supriyo B Chatterjee Elting Center for Innovation and Entrepreneurship Danny Briere
